mutants.note: exp(a + mx) is exp(a - mx) times the constant exp(2mx), cancelled by the normalisation; it differs only on overflow (max theta > ~355). Probed 600 synthFitCovariates fits (P 2-4, single and multi, maxEval 160 and 400; theta reached 428): 0 changed preRmspe, because an overflowed V gives a NaN loss that never replaces the best fit and only arises once the softmax has saturated on a plateau. Not proven unreachable; a future guard would be a fit forced to theta > 355 with a non-flat loss.

real_defects.issue: parseCovariates split every line on , ; and tab regardless of the file's delimiter: a semicolon file from a comma-decimal locale ('unit;income' / 'a;3,5') read as two covariates 3 and 5 under one header name (balance table with a phantom 'covariate 2' and a wrong income); a quoted unit name with a comma ('"Washington, DC"') was split; a repeated unit row silently replaced the first. Fixed: read with engine.mjs splitLine/numCell like the data CSV, rows must match the header's count, duplicates refused. Test: synth-cli.test.mjs 'covariates: decimal commas...'.

parsePayTable split on , ; and tab together: 'Engineers;3200,50;3400,00' (a comma-decimal locale, the EU Directive's own users) read women 3200, men 50, a -6300% gap flagged for joint pay assessment, no error. Fixed: a line with ; splits on ; and tab, decimal commas and dot thousands read (3.200,50 -> 3200.5, 52.000 -> 52000). Test in calc.test.mjs.

parseLayers: 'Gypsum;0,06;2860' in SI read as a layer 'Gypsum, 0' with R 6 (100x), no error. Same fix as the pay table. parseClimate has the same split but refuses the result ('too many values'), left alone.
